question: Which is volcano mountain?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kilimanjaro**__.

__
 
• **Volcanic Mountains are formed when molten rock (magma) deep within the earth, erupts, and piles upon the surface.​**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

**Kilimanjaro**

__
 
• It is a **dormant volcano in Tanzania.**
 
• It is **Africa’s tallest mountain at about 5,895 meters.**
 
• This mountain once had three volcanic cones – **Kibo, Shira, and Mawenzi. **
 
• In **1973, Mount Kilimanjaro National Park was established** to protect the mountain above the tree line as well as the six forest corridors that extend downslope through the montane forest belt.
 
• The park was designated a **UNESCO World Heritage site in 1987.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

**Aravali **

 
• It is a mountain range in** Northwestern India.**
 
• The **highest peak is Guru Shikhar at 1,722 meters.**
 
• The Aravallis **act as a barrier between the fertile plains** in the east and the sandy desert in the west.
 
• The Aravalli is rich in biodiversity and **provides habitat to 300 native plant species, 120 bird species, **and many exclusive animals like the jackal and mongoose.

**Appalachian**

 
• These are a system of mountains in **eastern North America.**
 
• A distinctive feature of the system is the **Great Appalachian Valley.**

**Ural**

 
• These are a **mountain range in Russia**.
 
• The Urals are rich deposits oil and natural gas.
 
• They also provide coal, iron, silver, gold, platinum, lead, etc.
 
• It also **represents the border between Europe and Asia.**
